summary: AquaBounty Technologies filed an 8-K reporting a private placement of 109,223 shares of Series B Convertible Preferred Stock, convertible into up to 2,184,460 common shares, for aggregate proceeds of $2.25 million. The offering, placed by Univest Securities (7.0% fee), closed on June 25, 2026. Proceeds are for working capital. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. The filing involves standard securities sales and is purely operational financing.
